sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
from collections import deque
names = ['G1','G2','G3','G4','R1','R2','R4']
coords = {'G1':(36,21),'G2':(36,27),'G3':(36,33),'G4':(36,39),'R1':(22,21),'R2':(22,27),'R4':(22,39)}
def key(d): return tuple(d[k] for k in names)
def get_slots():
    seg = current_frame.segmentation['nodes']
    slots = {}
    for n in seg:
        r0 = min(p[0] for p in n['boundary']); r1 = max(p[0] for p in n['boundary'])
        c0 = min(p[1] for p in n['boundary']); c1 = max(p[1] for p in n['boundary'])
        if 18 <= r0 <= 40 and (r1-r0) <= 5 and (c1-c0) <= 5 and n['pixels'] >= 9:
            slots[('R' if r0 < 30 else 'G') + str((c0-18)//6+1)] = n['color']
    return slots
st0 = get_slots()
print('st0:', sorted(st0.items()))
D = {'G1':'b','G2':'N','G3':'Y','G4':'M','R1':'R','R2':'p','R4':'O'}
# BFS from st0
start = key(st0); prev = {start: None}; q = deque([start])
while q:
    st = q.popleft()
    for i in range(7):
        for j in range(i+1, 7):
            lst = list(st); lst[i], lst[j] = lst[j], lst[i]; ns = tuple(lst)
            if ns not in prev:
                prev[ns] = (st, (names[i], names[j])); q.append(ns)
tgt = key(D); path = []
s = tgt
while prev[s] is not None:
    s, mv = prev[s]; path.append(mv)
path.reverse()
print('path to D:', path)
clicks = []
for a, b in path:
    ra, ca = coords[a]; rb, cb = coords[b]
    clicks += [{'action':'MOUSE','row':ra,'col':ca}, {'action':'MOUSE','row':rb,'col':cb}]
action(clicks)
st = get_slots()
print('state:', sorted(st.items()), 'match D:', st == D)
if st == D:
    res = action(['SPACE'])
    print('SPACE done', res.get('done'), 'level_completed', res.get('level_completed'), 'reward', res.get('reward'))
    print('level', current_frame.level, 'step', current_frame.step)
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
